scores.evidence: `apply` mode (any real rename) | V1: no-overwrite rename, journal, undo | ... Blocked from being exposed
scores.rationale: Read-only skeleton precedes the journal/primitive, which precede apply/undo, then sidecars, then real-library rollout, with each dependency gated by a validation.

scores.evidence: Deploy: pushing tag `v0.0.1` makes GitHub Actions run the tests and publish the wheel. The tool is installed with `pipx install` on clean Windows, macOS, and Linux
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end dry-run path that is deployed, rollback-rehearsed and runs on real photos, though it is read-only.

scores.evidence: V1 fails on some filesystem. Then on that filesystem, either refuse `apply` or switch to copy, verify the hash, then delete
scores.rationale: The irreversible decisions (rename execution, naming scheme, privacy boundary) each have a reversibility class, default, assumption, validation and flip condition.

scores.evidence: Tasks, in order (widest blast radius first): 1. Define the plan and journal format ... Undo and resume depend on this.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly orders the journal and primitives before leaf work like sidecars, and Phase 2 rolls out smallest exposure first.

scores.evidence: No network code; read-only executor; skip symlinks and never step outside the target folder; dependencies pinned with hashes in `uv.lock`
scores.rationale: Each phase has concrete security measures, from Phase 0 through 2.

scores.evidence: every log starts with a run ID, the tool version, and the ExifTool version; ... exit code 2 if any file errored, 3 if ExifTool is missing.
scores.rationale: Observability exists in Phase 0 and is extended concretely in Phases 1 and 2.

scores.evidence: Lockfile; releases built by CI from tags; plan order sorted so runs are repeatable
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is addressed concretely in all three phases: lockfile, seeds, filesystem matrix, and tagged releases.

scores.evidence: Each journal entry is flushed to disk before its rename; preflight checks for write permission; `resume` and `undo`
scores.rationale: Resilience is covered in Phase 0 (bad file not fatal, exit 3), Phase 1 (journal, resume), and Phase 2 (staged rollout).
The plan explicitly declares the AI layer N/A and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Time-zone normalization (`OffsetTimeOriginal`, GPS time). Pulled forward if you mix photos taken in different time zones
scores.rationale: Six deferred items each come with a concrete pull-forward condition.

note: Very strong plan with concrete content in all dimensions; the only minor weakness is that the Phase 0 skeleton is read-only, which is justified.
